title: Hendji PVP (Monolith) + Skybox
description: The PVP pack resource is presented in gray-white and black.
body:
## Hendji PVP (Monolith)
is a unique Resource pack presented in gray, white and black for battles with other players. If you value your monolithic nerves, style, convenience and skill, then this Resource pack is just for you.

## Skybox
Mods will be required to display the skybox.

- For Forge needed [Optifine](https://optifine.net/downloads)
- For Fabric needed [Skyboxify](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyboxify)
- Or [FabricSkyboxes](https://modrinth.com/mod/nuit) | [FabricSkyboxes Interop](https://modrinth.com/mod/nuit-interop)

### Changes

<details>
<summary>List of changes [ENG]</summary>

- Modified Swords
- Modified items
- Some sounds have been replaced
- No fire texture on screen when you burning
- Modified HUD
- Modified main menu

</details>

<details>
<summary>Список изменений [RUS]</summary>

- Изменённые мечи
- Изменённые предметы
- Некоторые звуки заменены
- Отсутствие огненной текстуры на экране при горении
- Изменённый HUD
- Изменённое главное меню

</details>
